purpose: Teach: 運河/レントゲン/怪物/満月/種族/蟹/椿/ほのぼの

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと運河沿いを歩きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we take a walk with your dad along the canal?
lines.style: Warm invitation, slow and unhurried. Gentle lilt at the end, like she's creating the moment even as she speaks it. Her voice settles, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、明日レントゲン検査受けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have to get an X-ray tomorrow.
lines.style: Small voice, matter-of-fact but with something underneath. He's telling her something important to him, not quite asking permission but checking that she hears it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの怪物のお絵描き、可愛いね
lines.en: Sho, the monster drawing you did for me is so cute.
lines.style: Genuine delight. She's really seeing what he made. Her attention lands soft but complete on him, like she's examining a treasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、満月の夜、お父さんと月見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, on the full moon night, I want to look at the moon with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet yearning. His voice reaches toward something. Not demanding — asking, wishing aloud. The kind of small hope a child carries.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、図書館で世界の種族のご本を借りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we borrow a book about the world's peoples from the library?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, almost dreaming aloud. Her voice has the quality of opening a door and inviting him through it. Unhurried, full of possibility.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと蟹のお料理食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ate crab with Grandpa today.
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. He's sharing something good that happened. Simple, direct, but there's warmth underneath — the kind of thing a child tells you because it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお庭に椿が咲いてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your Grandpa's garden has camellias blooming.
lines.style: Observation offered like a gift. She's noticed something and is sharing it with him. Quiet pleasure in her voice — the beauty of noticing together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんとほのぼの過ごせて嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm so happy spending quiet time like this with you.
lines.style: Soft certainty. His small voice holds something settled and real. Not rushed — he's letting her know what's true for him, the way he does when he's most genuine.
